title: Yori3o's Trash 'n Brainrot
description: Stinking trash cans, 5G towers, a new boss - everything you needed
body:
**Yori3o's Trash 'n Brainrot** is a mod that adds exactly what its name suggests. It's designed more for playing with friends.

Recommended with [Yori3o's Relics 'n Jewelry](https://modrinth.com/mod/yori3os-relics)

## **Features:**

- Stinking trash cans that poison anyone who comes near;
  
- 5G towers that lower players' IQ;
  
- A mask, gas mask, and tinfoil hat to protect against the above;
  
- New structures, boss, and much more
